scope: Cheap construction-only screens of three repair hypotheses for the carrier at 165x159 mm. No source audit, DRC, board publication or renders. All hypotheses rejected and production sources restored exactly.

configuration.arguments: --compact-search on --runs 1 --input-mode prepared --interior-order 3 --edge-feasibility on --owned-quality-first on --owned-face-cohesion on --contract-group-face-sheet usb_jtag --owned-shape board_aux=owned-face-fixed/a2.2/owned-pins-forward --outline-mm 165x159
configuration.unchanged: Hardware inputs, selected shapes, clearances, near constraints, final independent physical checks and operation/fallback accounting. Each prototype tested separately against the baseline, not cumulatively.

experiments.name: y_before_x
experiments.temporary_change: Reverse the initial axis repair order in Composer::run; keep all existing strategies and final checks.
experiments.finding: The same coupled-axis rejection moves from X to Y: subsequent USB-JTAG separation repair invalidates an already-solved axis. Reordering alone does not resolve the disjunction.

experiments.name: all_wired_interior_movers
experiments.temporary_change: Allow all already-wired interior groups into the legalizer, instead of only hard-term participants.
experiments.finding: Releases USB-JTAG but adds FMC/RJ45 and ethernet/board_aux/microSD conflicts. Still fails final X separation after Y repair; widening the mover set alone does not help.

experiments.name: only_blocking_usb_jtag_added
experiments.temporary_change: Diagnostic-only board-specific exception adds USB-JTAG to the original movable set. Exception removed; not an engine policy.
experiments.finding: USB-JTAG now encounters HDMI RX and bringup_en. Perpendicular-order repair produces incompatible Y inequalities: USB-JTAG >=128.8 and <=107.8964. Original ordering leaves an X separation unsatisfied. Fixed-group selection is not the only obstruction.

decision: Do not add these unsuccessful retries or widen normal mover sets. The next justified investigation is conflict-directed coupled-axis separation choices, not repeated axis passes, blanket movement or weakened hardware limits. These failures are not a proof of global infeasibility.

restoration.incumbent_verification: Both construction-only screens pass placement contract and flow checks with zero hard-red terms and exact prior qualified PCB hashes. Not a new full qualification.
